name: Lily
source: An adult human, Lily runs the local bar which she inherited from her dad. Hard-drinkin', hard-ridin', and hard… well, you get the idea. That's Lily's idea of a real good time. She's a girl who loves adventure and danger, and with the MC around she'll have plenty of both…
